authority: WB-D144 explicit user brackets/per-roll policy; WB-D145 delegated boundary convention
supersedes: Single1/400–1/1500 future Challenge eligibility bracket and encounter-aggregate classification; v1 data/quotes remain historical.
tier_metric: Unmultiplied reported specific-item per-roll probability in reviewed source/personal context; reciprocal denominator handles non-unit fractions.
conditional_policy: Do not choose a favorable semicolon/task/group alternative. Review explicit context first; unresolved/approximate expressions stay held. Personal fresh-source completion remains mandatory.
personal_encounter_probability: Keep separately for truthful expected effort/reward estimates; it does not choose the bracket under the new user rule. Never label per-roll as exact per-kill probability.

unlock_structure_proposal.recommended: Progressive Lesser → Standard → Greater → Superior separate permanent card unlocks; exact prerequisites/prices and inherited old entry gate pending answer.
unlock_structure_proposal.alternative: Independent tier purchases after a common entry gate.
unlock_structure_proposal.control_recommendation: Retain lower tiers; opt in/out of owned tiers between assignments before new offers. Exact tier visible before target draw.
unlock_structure_proposal.offer_integration: Existing two/three offer slots, type frequencies and any generic-Challenge tier picker are not changed without a separate settled contract.
unlock_structure_proposal.minimum_creatures: Existing≥3 actual target diversity rule preserved; application to each tier needs concrete pool review, not automatic underfloor offers.
